notes.title: Anodyne 2 Physical OST + Box Set and MORE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/1f39a84752e26b33719d1ae563ad32826c947d17.png[/img]

Hey fans of Analgesic Productions! Hope you're enjoying our newly released game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/877810/Anodyne_2_Return_to_Dust/]Anodyne 2: Return to Dust[/url], as well as the 20% off coupon if you own Anodyne 1.

I'm happy to announce we're working with The Yetee on some amazing Physical Merch:

- A Physical Edition with full-color 24 page manual and a clear-orange "game disk" etched with a Steam Key
- A physical, orange tape of the soundtrack
- A T-shirt of Nova's three forms
- A pin of Nova

If you'd like to dive in and check stuff out, go right here: [url=https://theyetee.com/collections/anodyne]https://theyetee.com/collections/anodyne[/url]

More details below!

[h1]Limited Physical Edition[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/5d983d4b8b87aa0ed999966f21bd3c1d146ec543.png[/img]

For $45, you can get a retro-style "Tallbox" case, containing a beautiful, 24-page, illustrated 'game manual' created by Marina Kittaka. You'll also receive a clear, orange "game disk" etched with a Steam key you can use for yourself or a friend! These items are beautiful and when you view them you'll be able to recollect fond memories of exploring Anodyne 2's New Theland.

[b]The Manual:[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/485e801e57dc69d9fc703d30f80d221bf08eed67.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/f384c7904614cc07007ee779541468d8f94cd75c.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/afbdbe61e51df26daaff6a95c78ddaa388d76f3b.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/fb173b81a11f2c1bee4f423e592ac1289f977076.png[/img]

[b]The Disk[/b]
 
(See above)

[h1]Tape Soundtrack[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/722d84264781845bd63d831d27e3499c31f9ca6a.png[/img]

For $10, we're selling the game's OST in physical tape form. This comes in a beautifully designed case showing Nova shrinking down.  The tape itself is a nice, transparent orange color, matching Anodyne 2's title screen and beginning level. It also comes with a DRM-free download of the game's music! You can put this into a tape player and imagine it's the soundtrack to a mysterious world...

[h1]T-shirt and pin[/h1]
For $20, you can own a nice, blue T-shirt with an original illustration by Marina Kittaka of Nova in her three forms - Ridescale, Walkscale, and Nanoscale! 

For $10, you can own a 1" soft enamel  pin of Nova in her 2D form. Perfect for bags or backpacks, and chance, fated encounters with mutual Anodyne 2 fans.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/5a199c23222348b089b390178fe593a07bf1414a.png[/img]

Again, the store page for the collection is here: https://theyetee.com/collections/anodyne

That's it! Please check out Anodyne 2 if you haven't yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/877810/Anodyne_2_Return_to_Dust/

notes.title: Announcing the Anodyne 2 Week 1 Edition, pricing, and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33027219/7912423cf03f2fd6562a47ac486c9afc873433cc.png[/img]

Hey everyone! Sean Han Tani, Director of Analgesic Productions here. Thanks for your support of our games Anodyne, Even the Ocean or All Our Asias!

First off, I'm pleased to announce Anodyne 2 will be releasing later this summer for $19.99. The Anodyne 2 OST will also release, featuring over 80 minutes of music, for only $4.99!

For release week, the game will be 10% off ($17.99)!

If you haven't yet, wishlist Anodyne 2 over here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/877810/Anodyne_2_Return_to_Dust/

Today I want to talk about THREE exciting things relating to the release of Anodyne 2: Return to Dust, and ways to save money when buying the game!

[list]
[*] Anodyne 2: Week 1 Edition 
[*] Anodyne Franchise Bundle
[*] Anodyne Loyalty Coupon
[/list]


[h1]Anodyne 2: Week 1 Edition[/h1]

For [b]ONLY the first week of release[/b], you'll be able to purchase a special complete-the-set bundle featuring both Anodyne 2 and its 80+ minute OST. We'll be pricing this at around $17.99***, meaning the OST is nearly free!

We recommend this bundle for owners of Anodyne 1 who enjoyed my music in the previous game and are planning to purchase the music.** 

[h1]Anodyne Franchise Bundle[/h1]

We'll be launching a complete-the-set bundle consisting of Anodyne 1 and Anodyne 2 as well. This is perfect for anyone looking to get into the series! 

And for launch week*, we'll also be including the Anodyne 2 OST in here as well! Pricing will be $17.99 + cost of Anodyne 1 at the time.

[h1]The Anodyne Loyalty Coupon[/h1]

Have you played Anodyne 1 yet? If not, picking it up now is a great idea, as upon release all owners of Anodyne 1 will receive a 10% off coupon for Anodyne 2! In fact, purchases of Anodyne 1 up to two weeks after Anodyne 2's release will also be given a coupon - even if you buy it in the franchise bundle.

Coupons are also applicable towards the aforementioned bundles!

Therefore, you can get up to 20% off on Anodyne 2 by being a player of Anodyne 1! You can even send this coupon to a friend.


---

* After launch week, the Anodyne Franchise bundle will consist of only Anodyne 1 and Anodyne 2. Purchasers of the bundle in the first week of Anodyne 2's release will NOT lose the Anodyne 2 OST. Purchasers of the bundle AFTER the first week will NOT receive the OST. The pricing of the bundle will be updated accordingly from $17.99 + Ano1 price w/ discount, to Ano2 + Ano1 price w/ 10% discount.

** Please note that the cheapest way to get the OST and Anodyne 2 is to buy the Week 1 Edition. Due to the bundle system, purchasing the game at $17.99 and then the complete the set bundle will be more expensive

*** Due to the bundle pricing system, the price of the Week 1 Edition bundle will be a few cents over or under $17.99.



(Note: prices and promotional periods may change.)
